title: File Coordination Markers
summary: Inline and sidecar coordination markers for safe multi-agent file edits.

sections.content: Agents claim files before edits, release them after edits, and scan markers before touching shared work. JSON and generated outputs use the sidecar ledger only.

items: active: file is currently owned by a session.
released_modified: file changed and may accept additive follow-up work.
released_readonly: file was inspected or tagged but not modified.

sections.content: Inline markers are only inserted where comments are safe. The sidecar ledger records every claim and release event append-only.
